Final score: Red (me) 49, Blue 27, so I finished 22 points ahead.

Strategy: I tracked the game as a running score difference. All number cards get played, so the plain sum of my numbers minus Blue's is fixed, and what decides the result is who gives up or steals which number. Early on I used approximate models of the rest of the game: I spent my lowest numbers on Steal and Trap and kept a Trap back to guard my high numbers against Blue's last Steal, since Blue was holding its 1 to steal with. From round 7 on I solved the remaining rounds exactly. Where the solution said several options had the same expected value, I picked the one whose result changed least with Blue's random choice.

Other commands or tools used: none
